latest.title: Who doesn't call an ambulance for chest pain
latest.finding: EMS use for ACS ranged 36–79%; under-49s up to 68% lower odds of EMS use than over-65s, men up to 11% lower than women, overseas-born up to 15% lower, non-English speakers 6–20% lower, remote residents up to 25% lower than major-city residents

latest.title: Prehospital ultrasound as a decision tool
latest.finding: POCUS may identify cardiac activity and reversible causes in arrest, characterise shock mechanisms and improve diagnostic confidence in cardiogenic pulmonary oedema; E-FAST has high specificity but limited sensitivity so it cannot be used as a rule-out test

latest.title: How Utah widened paramedic oxytocin scope
latest.finding: State EMS protocols changed in April 2024 to allow paramedic oxytocin for PPH prevention and AEMT intramuscular oxytocin for PPH prevention and treatment

latest.title: HEMS vs road: guideline adherence in trauma
latest.finding: HEMS transport associated with higher intervention rates across all indication-based subgroups: advanced airway in impaired consciousness 96.5% vs 82.9%, chest tube placement 50.5% vs 40.9%, despite HEMS patients being younger and more severely injured
